description: The plain-language summary of a Wikipedia article in any language edition: title, short description, lead extract, canonical URL, thumbnail and coordinates when the subject has them. Falls back to the best matching title. Query: ?title=Guadeloupe&lang=fr — $0.005000/call, paid per request via x402 (USDC). Use when asked: "wikipedia summary of guadeloupe", "what is x402 on wikipedia", "encyclopedia entry for".
name: wiki_summary
